en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town in a rural landscape. In the foreground are tree‑lined parks and lawns; beyond them stand clustered houses and industrial buildings with tall chimneys. A prominent church or town‑hall tower with a clock and onion‑shaped spire rises near the center. Fields and gently rolling, forested hills frame the background, with a river or lake visible to the right.
